data.name: Alesha
data.gender_notes: Alesha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman born during the night hours. In Arabic, the name is derived from the root words ‘al’ meaning night and ‘sha’ meaning born. The name evokes images of the beauty and mystery of the night. The name Alesha carries the meaning “Night-born” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Alesha usually hope their child will grow to embody night-born and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the divine feminine and the mysteries of the night. The name Alesha is believed to bring grace, beauty, and a sweet disposition to those who bear it.
data.etymology: Alesha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night-born.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alesha total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: اليشا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم غير مشتق من القرآن ولكنه يحمل معاني جميلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اليشا اسم علم مؤنث غير وارد في القرآن الكريم بشكل صريح، ولكنه مشتق من الألفاظ التي تعبر عن الحسن والجمال. يُستخدم الاسم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الفتاة الجميلة أو ذات الشخصية المميزة. وعلى الرغم من عدم وجوده في النصوص القرآنية، إلا أنه يحمل معاني إيجابية وجميلة في اللغة العربية.

in_urdu.name: الیشا
in_urdu.meaning: ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز نام جو اسلامی ثقافت میں استعمال ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: الیشا ایک ایسا نام ہے جو جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں مقبول ہے۔ اس کا مطلب خوبصورت یا خوش کردار فرد سے ہو سکتا ہے۔ یہ نام براہ راست قرآن کریم سے نہیں لیا گیا ہے، لیکن اس کی جڑیں عربی زبان میں ہیں جو اسلامی ثقافت میں گہرا تعلق رکھتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलीशा
in_hindi.meaning: एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में प्रयोग किया जाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीशा एक ऐसा नाम है जो भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है। इसका अर्थ सुंदर या अच्छे चरित्र वाले व्यक्ति से हो सकता है। यह नाम सीधे कुरआन से नहीं लिया गया है, लेकिन इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं जो इस्लामी संस्कृति में गहरा संबंध रखती हैं।

in_pashto.name: الیشا
in_pashto.meaning: د ښکلی نجلۍ یا ښځې نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: الیشا د پښتو کلتور کې یو منل شوی نوم دی چې ښکلا او ښه رنګیانو ته اشاره کوي. دا نوم په مستقیم ډول د قرآن کریم څخه نه دی اخیستل شوی، مګر د عربي کلمو څخه جوړ شوی دی چې په اسلامي کلتور کې کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Alesha
in_english.meaning: A beautiful and meaningful name used in Muslim cultures
in_english.long_meaning: Alesha is a name derived from Arabic roots, commonly used in various Muslim cultures. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, it carries meanings related to beauty, kindness, and nobility. The name reflects positive attributes and is chosen for its pleasant connotations and cultural significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alesha is associated with the Islamic cultural belief of the significance of the night hours. In many Muslim societies, night hours are considered more virtuous for prayer and spiritual reflection, as the Prophet Muhammad is reported to have said, "The best prayers after the obligatory prayers are those performed in the night." (Sahih Muslim 1176) This cultural value is reflected in the name, making Alesha a unique and beautiful name for a girl born during the night.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spiritual tradition, the night is believed to be a time of increased spiritual connection to Allah. The name Alesha, meaning 'night-born', carries this spiritual significance. The Prophet Muhammad is reported to have said, "Our Lord descends every night to the nearest heaven when one-third of the night remains, and He forgives more than the chest of the earth can contain." (Ibn Majah 1171). Thus, the name Alesha can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual potential that comes with the night, and a blessing for a little girl who was born during those hours.
